title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
BOJ hiked 25bp to 1.25% (31-year high), 7-2 vote — yen carry unwind risk elevated.
TOTAL3 -7.57% (24h) to $802B — altcoin weakness persists post-FOMC.
TOTAL2 -5.16% (24h) to $1.10T — ex-BTC cap under sustained pressure.
BTC.D +2.61% (24h) to 58.15% — dominance rising as alts sell harder than BTC.
BTC +0.75% at $76,215 — holding support; BOJ hike may soften DXY headwind.
